description: A domain knowledge document — what a sub domain-skill was. Same body as domain-skill/v1: the author's md, stored verbatim. The consumer (fdc-agent-be-spring SkillMarkdownTool) reads it as a sub skill: each heading under ## 도메인 지식 is one piece, a main's link makes it LINK1, its ## 데이터 queries are candidates. akg refuses an `##` section it does not know and requires ## 도메인 지식 (envelope.mjs semantic check).

markdown.description: The whole document as the author wrote it. Stored and served byte-for-byte; the renderer only prefixes a SKILL.md frontmatter.
